intro.text: Rebeke's brother, a Beaconite on Canticle who set their mother's sunheart into his and Rebeke's quadcycle.
A citizen of Beacon on Canticle and brother of Rebeke and Elegy. Though he held no official post, the Beaconites respected him and to some extent followed him.

items.text: After their mother sacrificed herself to become a sunheart, Divinity installed the sunheart in his and Rebeke's quadcycle so that Rebeke could keep it near her.

Divinity rode the quadcycle with Rebeke on the rescue mission at Union, carrying a rifle. Against the Greater Good's explicit orders, they planned to take Elegy during the assault. Intent on finding her, he paid no attention to Nomad's call for help, found the half-conscious Elegy and, with Rebeke, strapped her into the cycle's back seat.
From the deck of his ship, the Cinder King shot Divinity twice with an energy rifle; the second shot killed him instantly. Under continued fire, Rebeke had to leave his body behind in Union's arena.
Visiting the Chorus' Reliquary, Rebeke believed she saw Divinity's face among the shades.

personality.text: He was fervent about finding Elegy, knowingly risking his life to do so, yet treated her with great caution once she was a Charred who remembered nothing of him.
He looked after Rebeke's wellbeing after their mother's death.
